description.value: Mrs. Riches is a long-running family restaurant in downtown Nanaimo, serving an eclectic mix of Canadian, Continental, Asian, Spanish, Tex-Mex, and South Western fare made from fresh ingredients for over 30 years. The kitchen is helmed by Chef Pierre and the restaurant is locally famous for the K2 Mountain Burger — two pounds of prime beef with the works — which is free if you finish it and the fries in 30 minutes. The restaurant has been featured on the Food Network and also offers full catering services for events.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and corroborates OSM address (199 Fraser St, Nanaimo, BC V9R 5C1), phone (250-753-8311), and website URL. The website's menu page explicitly lists a 'GLUTEN FREE MEALS' section and a 'VEGAN TOFU BUDDA BOWL', confirming vegetarian/vegan/GF options. The site features a prominent 'ORDER NOW & VIEW MENU' button suggesting takeout is offered. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities anywhere in the website content. One notable discrepancy: the OSM name is 'Mrs. Riches Restaurant' but the website footer and contact sections consistently identify the business as 'Mrs. Riches Club Cafe'.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Mrs. Riches Restaurant' but the website footer and all contact sections consistently identify it as 'Mrs. Riches Club Cafe'. The OSM name may be outdated or informal.
Website still displays COVID-era protocols (mask mandates, contact tracing lists) suggesting some content has not been updated since 2020-2021, though the site also states 'We are now fully open'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, dine-in restaurant in downtown Nanaimo with a confirmed website, matching address and phone, and a broad menu suitable for hungry touring cyclists.
